submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE frame of the 16-frame two-step RUN cycle of the SAME fire talisman boy from reference 1, facing screen RIGHT / EAST. Single character only, not a sprite sheet. Genuine transparent RGBA background, native square at least 1024px each edge. No drawn ground, no shadow, no labels, no other characters.

Reference 1 is newly generated E01 and locks EXACT identity, anatomical proportions, image framing, head size, costume, rendering, side-view camera and invisible floor under the front shoe. Reference 2 is the original SE character and confirms identity and handedness. Reference 3 is approved PRIMARY painting style from designs, use only its refined clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted quality, not its UI. Keep all forms consistent with reference1; DO NOT zoom, crop, change face, change head volume, redesign clothes or relocate the whole character. Imaginary fixed ground and root do not move between frames. Running is in place, torso centered over SAME root. Only natural small pelvis/head bob allowed; preserve true foot flight above the same floor.

Immutable: brown high ponytail, ornate small red-gold crown with red hair ribbons, warm brown eyes and peach round boy face; red/gold flame-pattern short Daoist robe with ivory cuffs, black collar and trousers, black/red/gold shoes, taiji buckle and red waist tassels. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds three fanned red/gold talisman papers throughout, anatomical LEFT hand grips handle of brass bell with red tassel throughout. The camera sees RIGHT side nearer; objects must remain rigidly attached to their respective palm, no floating or switching hands. Bend elbows for athletic arm pumping; shoulders/elbows/wrists coordinate with legs. The right arm counter-swings the right leg, the left arm counter-swings the left leg. Hair ribbons, robe hem and tassels respond with small lag only. Complete clean silhouettes, no extra limbs, no motion blur, no speed lines, no FX.
Frame phase: E/03. RIGHT foot supports under the pelvis, knee bent, body passing over support. LEFT thigh swings forward with heel tucked below buttock, shoe still well above floor. Head/pelvis remain low but start rising. BOTH elbows bent about 90 degrees; RIGHT talisman arm passes close to waist moving forward, LEFT bell arm passes down close to waist moving backward. Keep hand objects separate from torso.
